title: Conformal Certification of Reasoning Trace Prefixes
abstract: arXiv:2605.30085v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Language model reasoning traces are rarely all-or-nothing; they frequently contain valid intermediate steps before a critical error occurs. Existing uncertainty quantification methods typically certify final answers or entire responses, failing to provide statistical guarantees for the proportion of a sequential trace that can be safely retained. To address this, we introduce CROP (Conformal Reasoning Output Prefixes), a verifier-agnostic calibration procedure for clean-prefix certification. Given any step-level risk proxy, CROP selects a calibrated threshold and returns the longest contiguous prefix whose step risk proxies remain below it, routing the uncertified suffix for downstream review or repair. Assuming exchangeability, CROP rigorously controls the marginal probability that the returned prefix contains an annotated error. translated_title: 推理轨迹前缀的保形认证
translated_abstract: 语言模型的推理轨迹很少是非黑即白的；它们通常在出现关键错误之前包含有效的中间步骤。现有的不确定性量化方法通常只对最终答案或完整响应进行认证，无法为序列轨迹中可安全保留的比例提供统计保证。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 CROP（Conformal Reasoning Output Prefixes，保形推理输出前缀），这是一种与验证器无关的干净前缀认证校准程序。给定任意步骤级风险代理指标，CROP 会选择一个经过校准的阈值，并返回步骤风险代理指标始终低于该阈值的最长连续前缀，同时将未认证的后缀交给下游进行审查或修复。在可交换性假设下，CROP 严格地控制了返回前缀包含标注错误的边际概率。在六个带有过程标注的推理数据集上，我们证明了标准的步骤级指标……
tldr: CROP 是一种与验证器无关的保形校准方法，可为语言模型推理轨迹的连续前缀提供统计错误率保证——返回可安全保留的最长干净前缀，并将未认证部分交由下游审查修复。
en_tdlr: CROP is a verifier-agnostic conformal calibration procedure that provides statistical control over error probability for contiguous prefixes of language model reasoning traces, returning the longest certified clean prefix and routing the uncertified suffix for downstream review or repair.
